candidate.answerReason: Real numbers correspond one-to-one with number-line points. Irrational numbers also have such points, zero is rational, and zero is neither positive nor negative.

methods.label: Real numbers and number-line points
methods.explanation: Points on the number line represent both rational and irrational numbers, and real numbers correspond one-to-one with points on the number line. Real numbers are divided into three categories: positive real numbers, \(0\), and negative real numbers. \(0\) is rational.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 real-number classification, number-line correspondence, and the status of zero.
